en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a wide urban square with landscaped gardens and paths in the foreground, a central statue/monument, and a row of 2–3 story historic buildings and shops lining a broad street. A tower of a church or civic building rises in the middle distance. Horse-drawn vehicles and pedestrians are visible. The caption at the bottom reads "Cluj" on the left and "Piața Unirii — Egyesülési-tér" on the right.
